title: Visualize ranking signals within priority rows
description:
As an optimization operator, I want every ranked priority row to show comparable visual signals for opportunity, feedback volume, and disagreement rate, so that I can judge relative scale without opening a chart tooltip.

Out of scope: changing ranking calculations or policy gates.

Feature: Ranked priority signal visualization

Scenario: Compare ranking opportunity in the priority list
Given a report contains multiple ranked score opportunities
When the operator views the priority list
Then each row shows a ranking-opportunity bar scaled consistently across the visible list
And the exact reviewed-disagreement count remains readable

Scenario: Compare feedback evidence in the priority list
Given ranked scores have different valid feedback volumes and disagreement rates
When the operator views the priority list
Then each row shows a feedback-volume bar scaled consistently across the visible list
And each row shows a disagreement-rate bar on a fixed zero-to-one-hundred-percent scale
And the exact valid-feedback count and disagreement percentage remain readable

Scenario: Handle missing or zero evidence
Given a ranked row has missing or zero signal evidence
When the operator views the priority list
Then the row remains readable without implying positive evidence
And the list layout remains stable.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation started. The ranked-list visualization will use list-wide relative bars for reviewed-disagreement opportunity and valid-feedback volume, preserve exact values and disagreement percentage, and leave ranking and policy calculations unchanged.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented three aligned visual signals in each ranked priority row: reviewed-disagreement opportunity relative to the visible maximum, valid-feedback volume relative to the visible maximum, and disagreement rate on a fixed zero-to-one-hundred-percent scale. Exact values remain visible; missing evidence renders as zero or unavailable. Focused report/chart tests pass (5 tests), dashboard web typecheck passes, and the live local Report was visually verified in split and full-width layouts.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Committed the validated ranked-priority signal visualization as 620ca7882. The story remains in progress until the change lands through the integration path.
